why: ChatGPT answered with one product type, a portable power station sized to the trip (about 250–500 Wh for a weekend, 700–1,000 Wh for a fridge), and listed solar charging only as an optional feature, not something the shopper must add. The fact that decides the purchase is Wh capacity and battery chemistry (LiFePO4) matched to the devices and trip length, which a single-product comparison covers, so the multi-item test fails.
